_about: Woodex Interior's official identity: one NAP, opening hours, the founding year, its Google Business Profile and the social profiles that were checked. tools/apply-entity.py writes it into every page — schema, footer, map links, the hours the chrome prints, llms.txt — for frontend-v1 by default and for the older v26 pages at the repository root with `--root .`; after a change here run the tool, and `--check` (CI) fails while any page disagrees. The admin console's Business info screen writes the same facts into the pages it edits — the footer's social row and the schema's sameAs in one save — so after a save there, run the tool and commit what it rewrites. Add a profile only after checking that it is the studio's own.
name: Woodex Interior
_telephone_about: Two numbers are published and both are the studio's: the first is the one D-6 fixes as canonical and the one WhatsApp uses (wa.me/923224000768); the second is the other published line, shown as the second "Call" entry and carried by the admin's Business info screen as phone2. tools/apply-entity.py writes both into JSON-LD telephone and refuses a page that links a number that is not one of these two.

address.streetAddress: M-71, Zainab Tower, Model Town Link Road

hours._about: The studio's opening hours, confirmed by the owner on 15 October 2026: Monday-Saturday 10:00-19:30, Sunday closed. Every page's chrome and every page's JSON-LD openingHoursSpecification is written from here by tools/apply-entity.py. The Google Business Profile still shows the older 09:30-18:30 (entity.json/google._evidence recorded it that day) and correcting that listing is the owner's task, because only the owner can change it.
hours.prose: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 am to 7:30 pm. Closed on Sunday.

_foundingYear_about: Confirmed by the owner on 15 October 2026 (the site's 'since 2016' is right; the Facebook page's 'since 2015' is the outlier). tools/apply-entity.py writes it as JSON-LD foundingDate and corrects any other year a page states.

google._evidence: Google Maps listing 'Woodex Interior', category Interior designer, M-71 Zainab Tower, Model Town Link Rd, Lahore 54700, +92 322 4000768, website woodex.com.pk, Mon-Sat 09:30-18:30. The geo point is the listing's own pin. The place ID was derived from the listing's feature ID 0x391907cc17c680b7:0x430344ffa555c00 and opens the same listing.
google.embedQuery: Woodex Interior, M-71 Zainab Tower, Model Town Link Road, Lahore

footerSocial._about: The profiles shown as icons in the footer's social row, in the markup the admin's Business info screen writes. Keys are the admin's network keys. X is left out of the footer while the account is dormant; it stays in sameAs.

evidence.facebook: Page 'Woodex interior', Lahore, Pakistan: 'An interior designing firm based in Pakistan proudly serving since 2015'. Linked from the studio's previous website (archived 27 Dec 2024) and listed in that site's schema sameAs.
evidence.linkedin: Company page 'woodexinterior' (Architecture and Planning), shown by LinkedIn itself; the founder's profile lists woodexinterior, Lahore; ZoomInfo cites the same page with the M-71 Zainab Tower address.
evidence.x: Profile @woodexinterior: 'Woodex Interior believes in the power of design...'. Linked from the previous website and in its schema sameAs. Dormant: 4 followers, no recent posts.

toConfirm._about: Linked from the previous website or found by name, but not verifiable from outside. The owner confirms each one is the studio's and still active before it goes on the site.

notOurs._about: Look-alike accounts found while searching. Never link them.
notOurs.linktr.ee/woodex: Woodex furniture showroom in Shuwaikh, Kuwait (instagram be.woodex, view.woodex, woodex.grp)

sisterBrand.name: Woodex Furniture
sisterBrand.note: Office and custom furniture. Its own Google listing (LG 89, Zainab Tower, 4.7 from 15 reviews, Office furniture store) shares the phone number. It is a separate listing: never put its links in Woodex Interior's sameAs.
